response.answer:
The client continues to plan around the baseline customer target date of 2026-11-09, and has not accepted a new date or a reduced-scope pilot.

The latest QA forecast projects final regression completion on 2026-11-16, which conflicts with the customer target date of 2026-11-09, and Isabelle Wong has not issued QA sign-off.

Recorded delivery risks cite that the QA forecast of 2026-11-16 does not support the customer target of 2026-11-09, security sign-off remains pending, and specialist QA capacity is unavailable before 2026-10-16.

Security review for production release is pending without recorded sign-off, as Darren Ng has requested a final access-control walkthrough and proof that privileged access is logged.

Delivery schedule conflict escalation (D-ORC-002) is open under owner Sofia Lee, and no decision exists authorizing a later full-release date or a customer-approved pilot.

Company policy mandates documented QA completion, security approval, and a named on-call owner prior to production launch.

As a next step, conditional on the missing QA completion, security sign-off, and customer acceptance, leadership escalation D-ORC-002 must be resolved and customer conversations initiated regarding an updated plan or controlled pilot assessment.
